method.comparison: Use the same recorded direction and scope for both policies. Compare source blocks, unique source sentences, retained disagreements, ordinary files with a highlight, and useful locations for the labeled rewrites.
method.selection: Retain disagreement reservation. In each selection step prefer the source block represented by the fewest cards. Break ties in favor of a passage with classifier support, then by source order. Display at most six cards.
method.sources: Use three disjoint excerpts of three, five and three sentences separated by at least 80 original characters. Use exactly one labeled interior rewrite in the central excerpt. Carry forward admitted pairs. Use older government reports as development context.
